title: A Detective who is never wrong
blurb: Eight Residents, two Murderers, and a Detective whose every Finding is true. Being right is one thing; being believed is another.

title: Right four times in five
blurb: Eight Residents, two Murderers, and a Detective whose Findings are right four times in five. Nobody, the Detective included, knows which time is the fifth.

title: Bell glances and pet names
blurb: Eight Residents, two Murderers, among them a mayor with a motion for everything and a retired sailor with a nickname for everyone.

title: The tailor's eye
blurb: Eight Residents, two Murderers, and a tailor who notices what everyone is wearing. The shortest game here, and a good first watch.
